messages:
maria: Quick question — how do we want the console to display SLO thresholds when there are per-tenant grace windows and quota-based soft-fail routing?

jamal: I think we need an "effective threshold" view. Configured threshold + any tenant overrides + active quiet windows + sampling confidence = effective value we show and use for notify previews.

soph: UX idea: toggle between "configured" and "effective" and show a short breakdown panel: 
- source: global/tenant/rollout
- active suppression: yes/no (why)
- sampling confidence: high/med/low

maria: +1 on breakdown. We also need to show what would have fired historically (preview) if effective had been in place for the last 24h.

alerts-bot: [ALERT SAMPLE] tenant=acme svc=model-serving-prod metric=error_rate window=5m value=6.2% threshold=5.0% effective_threshold=6.5% suppression=grace_window

leo: That sample makes the problem obvious — effective_threshold > configured, so preview would NOT have alerted. We should make that explicit in the UI (big yellow pill: "suppressed by grace window").

jamal: API contract question: should effective values be precomputed per-tenant and stored, or computed on-demand? Precompute avoids query-time CPU but increases write work when overrides change.

maria: For rollouts we already recompute a small set of derived keys when policies change. Precompute with a TTL (5-10m) seems reasonable.

yana: Important: our telemetry sampling affects SLO math. For low-volume tenants we downsample telemetry 10x — that increases variance. We should surface a "confidence" numeric or categorical so engineers know whether to trust a preview.

jamal: Agreed. I propose effective_threshold API returns: { "value": "6.5%", "confidence": "low", "reason": "grace-window+downsample" } — we can add more structured reasons later.

maria: Example API snippet for discussion: 
```
GET /api/v1/slo/effective?tenant=acme&policy=error_rate_5m
=> {
  "effective_threshold": "6.5",
  "configured_threshold": "5.0",
  "suppression": "grace_window:2026-03-19T12:00Z->2026-03-19T12:30Z",
  "confidence": "low",
  "explain": ["tenant_override=+1.5%","grace_window_active","sampling=10x_downsample"]
}
```

leo: Two implementation notes: cache per (tenant,policy) key, invalidate on policy change or rollout step. Also store an enum for suppression type (grace/quiet/spillover) so UI can pick color coding.

soph: On the UI side I'll mock the toggle + historical preview. UX question: do we show both summary and raw metric series? I vote show series + shaded band for configured vs effective thresholds.

maria: Action items: jamal -> draft API PR with example payload and TTL/caching details. soph -> mock UI with toggle + shaded band + confidence badge. yana -> add a short doc about sampling impact and recommended thresholds for low-volume tenants. I'll add tests for sampling-weighted SLO calculations.

jamal: I'll start the API PR today. Will include example curl and an opt-in param `?include_history=true` for the 24h preview.

leo: Sounds good. One more: telemetry pipeline should emit a tiny flag `slo_confidence` so we don't recalc heuristics client-side.

maria: Great — thanks all. Keeping the preview conservative is fine, but we need transparency in the console so customers don't get surprised. :thumbsup:

soph: I'll post the mock in #design once it's up. :eyes:

alerts-bot: deploy-bot: notif: api/slo-service v2.4.1 deployed to staging (rollout=1/3)

maria: noted, will check the rollout impact on effective values after staging is live.
